sentences.en: The matter of his successor is still under debate.
sentences.zh: 关于他的继任者的问题仍在争论中。

sentences.en: Two is the only prime whose successor is prime.
sentences.zh: 2是唯一一个其后继数也是质数的质数。

sentences.en: His successors slowly undid his popular economic reforms.
sentences.zh: 他的继任者们逐渐取消了他深受欢迎的经济改革。

senses.zh: 接替的人或事物, 继任者, 继承人
